## Data Protection Policy

Legal & Compliance

## 1. Principles

Personal data is processed lawfully, for specified purposes and kept no longer than necessary, in line with the GDPR.

The Data Protection Officer is Anne Laakkonen, reachable at [EMAIL]

## 2. Breaches

Personal data breaches must be reported to the DPO within 24 hours of discovery; the DPO notifies the authority within 72 hours where required.

## 3. Data subject requests

Access and deletion requests are answered within 30 days. Requests are logged in the privacy request register.
